Which setting holds the store's own country that the Terms place in store settings (دولته في إعدادات المتجر, S02-ZD-055), and whether it is the country of the business address (العنوان التجاري, business_location) or of the location given at sign-up

Who checks the store's country, and how, for a store outside Saudi Arabia: the pages read state checks only for Saudi stores (the national address certificate from سُبل SPL, S02-ZD-085 and S02-ZD-154; the Saudi Business Center verification, S02-ZD-090), and is_address_confirmed (S02-ZD-148) has no description

The contracting party and the terms for a merchant outside Saudi Arabia (in Egypt, the UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar or Syria, and in Kuwait outside Zid Pay): the Terms name one entity and Saudi law for the services in general (S02-ZD-001, S02-ZD-003); Zid Egypt's registration (S02-ZD-062) and the partner in Syria (S02-ZD-139) are not tied to a contract with merchants

How the platform holds the countries it serves merchants in: the list of countries a store can take as its own at sign-up or in store settings (the sign-up articles state a location set by hand or from the browser, S02-ZD-037 and S02-ZD-088)

(a), where it holds it: where Automattic holds the merchant's country of residence that the Terms read to name the contracting entity (S02-WC-013 to S02-WC-015), and where the WooPayments account's country, selected at signup (S02-WC-180, S02-WC-182), is held once the account exists. Stated: the store's Country / State option (S02-WC-113) and the Payments settings' business location (S02-WC-221, S02-WC-222).

(b), who checks it: whether anyone verifies the country the merchant enters, for the store's Country / State (S02-WC-113), the Payments settings' business location (S02-WC-221) or the WooPayments account's country selected at signup (S02-WC-182). The KYC page lists 'Country where your business is based' among the information asked (S02-WC-185) and says WooCommerce works with Stripe to confirm the merchant's identity (S02-WC-186), without saying the country is checked.

(b), on what conditions: any condition on changing the store's Country / State (woocommerce_default_country, S02-WC-113) once the store has orders, tax rates or a WooPayments account, and what a change carries to other settings. Stated: the WooPayments account's country cannot be changed later (S02-WC-182); account information can't always be changed once saved (S02-WC-187); WooCommerce Tax asks the merchant to update the store address if the business moves (S02-WC-119).

Who checks the store's country: the global country set under Settings › Localization (store_country), the hosting region chosen at sign-up, or the country of residence that picks the contracting entity
